nodes.description: uint256 price; sale price per token used in mint cost check
uint256 maxPerAddress; cap on total tokens claimed per address
bytes32 whitelistRoot; Merkle root used for whitelist verification
mapping(address=>uint256) claimedByAddress; tracks claimed tokens per address
uint256 startTimestamp; sale start time compared against block.timestamp
IMetaverseNFT public immutable nft; target NFT contract referenced for minting and extension checks
external payable mint(uint256 nTokens, bytes32[] proof); whitelisted paid mint that forwards ETH to nft.mintExternal
pure isWhitelisted(root, receiver, proof); builds leaf and verifies Merkle proof
onlyOwner updateMaxPerAddress(uint256); writes maxPerAddress
onlyOwner updateWhitelistRoot(bytes32); writes whitelistRoot
view saleStarted(); returns block.timestamp >= startTimestamp
onlyOwner startSale(); sets startTimestamp to block.timestamp
onlyOwner stopSale(); sets startTimestamp to __SALE_NEVER_STARTS
onlyOwner updateStartTimestamp(uint256); sets startTimestamp
internal view beforeMint(); requires nft.isExtensionAllowed(address(this))
nft.mintExternal{value: msg.value}(nTokens, msg.sender, bytes32(0)); external call forwarding ETH
claimedByAddress[msg.sender] += nTokens; state write performed after the external call
nTokens * price; multiplication in the ETH payment requirement
msg.sender; caller address used as proof receiver, mapping key and mint recipient
block.timestamp; miner-controllable time compared against startTimestamp
parameter nTokens of mint; number of tokens to mint
parameter proof of mint; Merkle proof array for whitelist check
parameter _maxPerAddress of updateMaxPerAddress
parameter _whitelistRoot of updateWhitelistRoot
local bytes32 leaf = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(receiver)) in isWhitelisted
parameter _startTimestamp of updateStartTimestamp
